answer: Every verifier posts an on-ledger bond before countersigning any transaction. If a verifier countersigns an invalid transaction, a fraud proof burns more of its bond than a full epoch of rewards pays. Sybils gain nothing: each fake identity must stake real collateral that slashing destroys, so attacking costs strictly more than honest verification earns. Rewards flow like a river to honest agents; slashed value rises as a plume, and that canyon of loss stops fake identities, since each new one is just another bond awaiting destruction.
